An active Ride can show an ongoing notification with Open and End Ride controls when notifications are allowed. A separate listener grant enables the current message and high-priority notification feed.
Review current and planned device access.
Mount and configure the phone while parked. Keep the system dialer and emergency controls available.
Edit your pages in landscape before riding, then open the saved dashboard. Live external controls arrive later.
Avoid complex setup while riding. Android will continue to manage calls and emergency dialing.
Starting Ride may ask to post notifications so its Open and End Ride controls remain available. PiP needs device support. A separate notification-access grant enables the music and message feed.
Music and the notification feed use a separate listener grant in Android Settings. Messages and high-priority alerts remain in memory only while active.
Selecting favorites may use the system picker. System Recents need a restricted call-log grant. Direct calls ask for a separate permission and confirmation; the system dialer remains the default.
A future tap-to-talk assistant would ask for microphone access when used. This version does not listen.
